text_block_list.text:
One day. Near the hollow of the giant 
tree—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Train with me?

text_block_list.name: Maruzen's Juniors
text_block_list.text:
Yes! We want to become just like you, 
Maruzen-san, our idol...! *gasp*!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you! I was just in the mood 
for a run today, too.

text_block_list.name: Maruzen's Juniors
text_block_list.text:
! *gasp*! We'll get ready and wait on the 
track! ...Let's hurry!

Whoops. Looks like someone beat us to the 
punch~.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
We thought we'd grab some tea together, 
but—looks like we got a late start.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh~~, my bad, my bad! Ramonu-chan, 
forgive me too, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: It matters not. Truly.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Geez~, you could at least act a little 
more disappointed~.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Or actually, how about it? Why don't you 
two join in and mingle with the juniors 
for once?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Not interested.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I'll pass too. Running in cramped quarters 
isn't really my thing.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Aha! Well, I figured you'd say that!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Then why did you even ask—wait.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I see. Your usual spoiled-brat mode, huh.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's right. Because you two turn 
me down, I can let my guard down and be 
spoiled around you.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hmph?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I just think they're so adorable. Whenever 
I look at those juniors—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
They look up to me so genuinely, and 
sometimes they even try to copy me.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Admiration becomes their strength, you 
know? They project their future selves 
onto me.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to show them my mature, 
grown-up side as much as I can, but—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Every now and then, I want to look at you 
two—who don't idolize me at all—and feel 
at ease...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
In other words, you two are truly 
irreplaceable to me♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! Can I join you for tea? Right 
after training!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
As you wish. Though whether I will still 
be here remains to be seen.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I'll be looking forward to waiting for 
you. —Come on, don't keep them waiting, 
get going.

One day. I spotted Maruzensky enjoying tea 
with her friends.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey Ramonu-chan♪ How about me as the model 
for your next painting?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I have enough.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Bummer! Turned down completely~~!

Her casual demeanor, looser than usual, 
showed just how close they truly were.
